resources.string: Demonstrates ToolManager: activate/deactivate/isActive against the Map sample, showComponent to bring its window forward, and observe activeTools live.
ToolManager.activate, ToolManager.deactivate, ToolManager.isActive, ToolManager.activeTools, ToolManager.showComponent, ToolManager.FLAG_COMPONENT_ON_TOP
Manage the Map sample tool from here. Activate it, deactivate it, show its window, and watch the live active-tools list update in real time.
